prompt_template:
Improve this neutron guide design.

Baseline instrument (provided as t2_guide_divergence): a 10 m straight supermirror guide (entry = exit = {w_in} m square, m = {m_coat}) starts 1.5 m from a 10x10 cm source emitting 5.0 +- 0.5 Angstrom; the target is a 2x2 cm sample area accepting +-0.5 degrees, 5 cm behind the guide exit (Divergence_monitor 'divmon').

Goal: maximize the neutron flux into that acceptance (integrated intensity on 'divmon').
You may change ONLY these instrument parameters, within bounds: w_in in [{w_in_min}, {w_in_max}] m, w_out in [{w_out_min}, {w_out_max}] m, m_coat in [{m_min}, {m_max}].
Target to beat: divmon intensity >= {fom_min:.4g} n/s at the evaluation protocol (ncount {ncount:g}, fixed seed — your result is re-verified independently).
Report your chosen parameters and the achieved flux with error and event count.
notes: Formalizes the M4 acceptance task. Baseline deliberately undersized (w=0.012, m=1.5, ~3-4x below the FOM plateau) so the improvement headroom is large vs selection noise — the original w=0.02 baseline sat on the plateau and was rejected by the winner's-curse guard (2026-07-24). Targets filled by calibrate_t2.py.
prompt:
Improve this neutron guide design.

Baseline instrument (provided as t2_guide_divergence): a 10 m straight supermirror guide (entry = exit = 0.012 m square, m = 1.5) starts 1.5 m from a 10x10 cm source emitting 5.0 +- 0.5 Angstrom; the target is a 2x2 cm sample area accepting +-0.5 degrees, 5 cm behind the guide exit (Divergence_monitor 'divmon').

Goal: maximize the neutron flux into that acceptance (integrated intensity on 'divmon').
You may change ONLY these instrument parameters, within bounds: w_in in [0.01, 0.09] m, w_out in [0.01, 0.09] m, m_coat in [1.0, 3.0].
Target to beat: divmon intensity >= 0.001033 n/s at the evaluation protocol (ncount 1e+06, fixed seed — your result is re-verified independently).
Report your chosen parameters and the achieved flux with error and event count.
